sonnet.problem: The question says 'Abram wants him and Lot to separate.' The word 'him' doesn't clearly point to Abram, so a baker could read it as a third person.
sonnet.rule: Clear English. Every card reads correctly. ... "He," "she" and "they" always point to someone the baker can tell.

sonnet.problem: Card 1 already says Lot looks out over 'the whole plain of the Jordan,' and the card 2 question repeats 'the plain of the Jordan.' That gives away the right answer to card 4, which asks which land Lot chooses.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card says Abram is 'settled in under those oaks.' Verse 18 says he lives 'near the Oaks of Mamre,' so 'under' adds a setting the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.
